verdict.rationale: Jan is documented as an open-source project with a public GitHub repo (janhq/jan), and the README gives a one-command path to build from source. That is the minimal basis for outside code contributions. Nothing in the evidence describes how contributions are accepted or how contributors become recognized collaborators. Missing for 10: a documented contribution guide or PR process, contributor recognition or maintainer pathway, governance or licensing details, and community or hands-on evidence of external contributions being merged.

support.subject: As a developer, I can contribute code and become a recognized collaborator through the project's open-source process

citations.quote: Jan is an open-source replacement for Claude and ChatGPT.
This handles everything: installs dependencies, builds core components, and launches the app.
